step_1_install_npcap.description: Install the Npcap kernel packet capture driver (Windows). Npcap enables user-space access to the Windows Packet Filter and is required for loopback (127.0.0.1) packet capture.

step_2_install_scapy.description: Install the Scapy packet manipulation library. Scapy uses Npcap on Windows to send and receive raw packets.

step_3_run_as_administrator.description: Run the server process with Administrator privileges. On Windows, Npcap-based loopback capture requires elevation.

cat_c_upgrade_path.upgrade_note: Once all three steps are satisfied, ml/feature_bridge.py can be extended to capture and parse raw Ethernet/IP/TCP frames on the loopback interface, extracting all 21 Category C features with full UNSW-NB15 semantic fidelity. Until then, the system correctly refuses live ML inference per the no-fabrication rule.
